title: FANTASTIC experience - unique & such fun
text: This has been our favourite tour of our entire 6 week trip in Europe. The experience was SO UNIQUE, the format is easy to follow, and the venue is gorgeous. Our host, Marcel, was so knowledgeable and friendly, and he was really helpful when we were stuck - but pushed us to really think about the wine. He also gave us hints on how to succeed at the game, making it accessible without dumbing it down for those less knowledgeable about wine. One group arrived quite late whilst the game was underway, yet he accommodated them gracefully. We absolutely loved it - so much so that we want to go again w
author: Sabrina_M

title: Fun Experience!
text: Very interactive wine "tasting" that is fun and educational. You get to try 6 wines with some tapas. You have to try to guess which varietal, country and year it's from. Lots of fun!
author: Nikki_Y

title: Bet on a really fun evening
text: This takes blind wine tasting to a delightfully fun and ultimately enlightening new level.  How does this work?  You are asked to provide your opinion on the varietal, the country of origin, and the vintage of each wine tasted.  You show your conviction by the size of your bets from none up to your total stake (which is provided when you begin).  The host gives various clues, some more cryptic than others.  You have a descriptive card that also helps to guide your wagers.  All are competing to take home a unique wine.  Our group had a blast.   I highly recommend this for a fun evening of wine
author: John_L

title: Highly recommend
text: What an experience, wine tasting at its best! The atmosphere, tapas and wine itself were top notch. Thorough and elaborate description for each type of wine you taste. Special thanks to Gleb for this journey, was very attentive and friendly.
author: wudankk

title: Highly recommended
text:
A perfect place to spend evening with friends or your beloved ones. Cozy atmosphere, friendly and highly professional staff. Also, have to mention Glib - the owner and his charming wife Dasha, who we met during our visit and had a lovely chat with. Super cool people!

title: Quality tasting
text: As withh all the other reviews, we had an excellent evening with Melissa for our private wine tasting.  The venue, beautiful cellar style with great ambience. Generous glasses of wines, Cava, 2 reds and 2 white, or really good quality and traditional snacks. Melissa's passion and knowledge was what really made the tasting special . Highly recommended
author: elizabethmcLeeds

title: Intimate hen do vermouth tasting - amazing afternoon
text: This was such a gem - a really beautiful place in an interesting area. The history of vermouth was fascinating, and we all enjoyed testing all the different varieties. Plus, great tapas too! Great value for money and a thoroughly enjoyable activity to do on a hen do. Was super appreciated by everyone and Melissa was amazing!
